बॉलीवुड की यंग स्टार Sara Arjun के हाथ लगा है एक बहुत बड़ा प्रोजेक्ट! 🎬❤️

Mid-Day की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Sara Arjun अब Yash Raj Films (YRF) के बैनर तले अपनी पहली फिल्म करने जा रही हैं। यह एक बिना नाम वाली म्यूजिकल लव स्टोरी होगी, जिसे Maneesh Sharma डायरेक्ट करेंगे। Maneesh इससे पहले Tiger 3, Band Baaja Baaraat और Shuddh Desi Romance जैसी फिल्में डायरेक्ट कर चुके हैं।

रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, इस फिल्म में 8 गाने होंगे, जो इसकी कहानी का अहम हिस्सा बनेंगे। Sapne vs Everyone फेम Ambrish Verma भी इस कास्ट का हिस्सा बताए जा रहे हैं। 🎵

खबर है कि फिल्म का प्री-प्रोडक्शन शुरू हो चुका है और जनवरी 2027 में पंजाब में इसकी शूटिंग शुरू होगी। हालांकि, अभी मेकर्स की तरफ से ऑफिशियल ऐलान होना बाकी है।

क्या आप Sara Arjun और YRF की इस नई रोमांटिक फिल्म के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

Sara Arjun is reportedly set to headline her first project with Yash Raj Films (YRF). According to a report by Mid-Day, the young actor has been signed for an untitled musical love story directed by Maneesh Sharma, who last helmed Tiger 3 (2023). The film is expected to go on floors in Punjab in January 2027, with pre-production currently underway.
A source told Mid-Day, “Sara’s next is a love story with YRF. Pre-production is underway and she will begin shooting for the film in Punjab in January.” Actor Ambrish Verma, known for his work in Sapne vs Everyone, is also reportedly part of the cast. Further details about the characters and the remaining cast members have not yet been revealed.
The project is said to be a musical with eight songs, making music an important part of its storytelling. While the makers have not officially announced the film, the reported collaboration brings together Sara and Sharma for a romance-driven project.
The film is also expected to mark Sharma's return to the genre that established him as a filmmaker. He previously directed romantic films such as Band Baaja Baaraat (2010), starring Ranveer Singh and Anushka Sharma, and Shuddh Desi Romance (2013), featuring Sushant Singh Rajput, Parineeti Chopra and Vaani Kapoor.
An insider told the publication, “Maneesh is known for modern-age romances like Band Baaja Baaraat and Shuddh Desi Romance . As he is collaborating with a young cast again, it will be exciting to see what he comes up with.”
Sharma's last directorial venture was Tiger 3 , starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif. His reported collaboration with Sara suggests a shift towards a younger cast and a musical romantic narrative.
For Sara, the project would mark her entry into the YRF banner, adding another significant project to her growing filmography. However, an official confirmation from the production house is awaited.
